description:
Burpee to plank is just like a traditional burpee, but we're cutting out the push up to save a little on the upper body stress. This variation works better during cardio circuits where you're breathing hard and when the full burpee just seems too daunting.

Remember that during really challenging cardio circuits, we don't want max height on the jumps. That's when your form turns to poo poo. Just enough to get off the ground. Aim to keep a good rhythm.
